title: Mallworld Geography
content: I have been having dreams in the same map for over three years. My identical twin sister described this dream map to me from her dreams with absolutely no prompting from me whatsoever. We dream of a world that has many facets but the major part is a large valley with a river that separates one half of the town from the other half of the town. Has anyone else experienced their mallworld being a full world town that is split in half by a river valley?
